name: The Defias Brotherhood
summary: In Westfall, The Defias Brotherhood still holds the farmlands in fear. Gryan Stoutmantle has found their stronghold beneath Moonbrook and calls for a final blow against their leader.

sections.title: A Sentence Passed
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia have fought the Defias Brotherhood across Westfall for months. Now the thieves' stronghold lies exposed beneath Moonbrook. Stoutmantle orders Edwin VanCleef assassinated, believing his death will break the rebellion once and for all.

sections.title: Into the Labyrinth
sections.body: You face winding shafts deep beneath the Deadmines, where renegade stonemasons, goblin engineers, and heavy iron blast doors guard the way. At the central dry dock, VanCleef oversees the final construction of his grand war vessel. His death would sever the command that holds the outlaw network together.

sections.title: Shadows of a Greater Conspiracy
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle believes VanCleef's death will begin the end for the Brotherhood. Yet an unsent letter rests on the fallen guildmaster's body. It hints that Westfall's uprising was tied to a wider web reaching into Stormwind City's nobility.

faq.q: What is the goal of this quest?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle asks you to enter the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook, kill Edwin VanCleef, and bring his severed head to Sentinel Hill.

Edwin VanCleef once served as Grand Mason of the Stonemasons Guild and led Stormwind City's rebuilding after the orcs razed it in the First War. After a bitter dispute with the House of Nobles over payment, he founded the Defias Brotherhood to seek vengeance on the kingdom.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle order an assassination?
faq.answer: The People's Militia lacks the regular army reinforcements from Stormwind needed for a long war. Stoutmantle sees the removal of the Brotherhood's leadership as Westfall's only realistic chance to break the syndicate's grip on the farmlands.

faq.q: Where can Edwin VanCleef be found?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef is hidden deep in the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook. Gryan Stoutmantle asks you to enter the hideout and find him.

faq.q: Does killing VanCleef destroy the Defias completely?
faq.answer: Stoutmantle hopes VanCleef's death will break the Brotherhood's hold on Westfall. The outcome and any further discoveries await the assault.

faq.q: What item of note is found on VanCleef upon his defeat?
faq.answer: Stoutmantle demands VanCleef's head as proof. Other discoveries inside the hideout come during the assault.

angles.text: As a human of the kingdom, you face a bitter tragedy in VanCleef's death: the artisan who rebuilt your capital from ashes.
As an Alliance member, you strike an early blow to secure Westfall's breadbasket while Stormwind's throne cannot spare its own troops.
As a rogue, you face VanCleef, a famed rogue and master artisan, in his inner sanctum. The clash tests the training of any stealth operative.
